name: V-Neck
description: A neckline that dips down in a V shape at the front, elongating the neck and flattering most body types

name: Round Neck
description: A classic circular neckline that sits close to the base of the neck

name: Off-Shoulder
description: A neckline that sits below the shoulders, exposing the collarbone and shoulders

name: Sweetheart
description: A heart-shaped neckline that dips in the center, creating a romantic silhouette

name: Square Neck
description: A straight-across neckline with right-angle corners, creating a structured look

name: Boat Neck
description: A wide neckline that runs horizontally across the collarbone, nearly reaching the shoulder points

name: Halter Neck
description: A neckline with straps that tie or fasten behind the neck, leaving shoulders and back exposed

name: Cowl Neck
description: A draped, fabric-folded neckline that creates soft, flowing folds

name: Scoop Neck
description: A deep, U-shaped neckline that scoops lower than a round neck

name: Illusion Neck
description: A sheer mesh or lace panel over the chest area, creating the illusion of bare skin while providing coverage

name: Keyhole Neck
description: A round neckline with a small cutout (keyhole) at the front or back

name: One-Shoulder
description: An asymmetric neckline with one strap, leaving one shoulder bare

name: Short Sleeve
description: Sleeves ending above the elbow, typically at mid-upper arm

name: Long Sleeve
description: Sleeves extending to the wrist

name: 3/4 Sleeve
description: Sleeves ending between the elbow and wrist

name: Puff Sleeve
description: Gathered sleeves that balloon out before tapering at the cuff or shoulder

name: Bell Sleeve
description: Sleeves that flare out from the elbow like a bell

name: Cap Sleeve
description: Very short sleeves that just cover the shoulder cap

name: Sleeveless
description: No sleeves — the garment ends at the shoulder seam

name: Flutter Sleeve
description: Short, loose sleeves that drape softly and flutter with movement

name: Raglan Sleeve
description: Sleeves that extend in one piece from the collar, with diagonal seam from underarm to collarbone

name: Kimono Sleeve
description: Wide, straight sleeves cut as one piece with the body of the garment

name: Mandarin Collar
description: A short, stand-up collar that does not fold over, originating from Chinese traditional wear

name: Peter Pan Collar
description: A flat, rounded collar lying flat against the garment

name: Notch Collar
description: A tailored collar with a V-shaped notch where the collar meets the lapel

name: Stand Collar
description: A tall, upright collar that stands against the neck

name: Shawl Collar
description: A rounded collar that rolls softly from the neckline without a notch

name: Spread Collar
description: A wide collar with points spread apart, commonly used in dress shirts

name: A-Line Skirt
description: A skirt that is fitted at the hips and gradually flares out toward the hem, resembling the letter A

name: Pencil Skirt
description: A slim-fitting skirt with a straight, narrow cut

name: Mermaid Skirt
description: A fitted skirt that flares out dramatically at or below the knee, resembling a mermaid tail

name: Flared Skirt
description: A skirt that flares outward from the waist, creating a full, circular silhouette

name: Pleated Skirt
description: A skirt featuring evenly spaced folds (pleats) for added volume and movement

name: Wrap Skirt
description: A skirt that wraps around the body and ties or buttons at the side

name: High-Low Skirt
description: A skirt with a shorter front hemline and a longer back hemline

name: Peplum Skirt
description: A skirt with a short, flared ruffle attached at the waistline

name: Straight Trouser
description: Trousers with a straight, consistent width from hip to hem

name: Wide-Leg Trouser
description: Trousers that widen from the waist or hip to create a flowing, relaxed silhouette

name: Palazzo Trouser
description: Very wide-legged trousers that flow dramatically from the waist

name: Tapered Trouser
description: Trousers that narrow gradually from the hip to the ankle

name: Flared Trouser
description: Trousers that fit snugly through the thigh and flare out from the knee

name: Agbada
description: A flowing wide-sleeved robe worn over an inner shirt (Buba) and trousers (Sokoto). Traditional Yoruba formal attire

name: Kaftan
description: A long, loose garment with wide sleeves, worn as a flowing dress or robe

name: Buba & Iro
description: Traditional Yoruba two-piece outfit — a loose blouse (Buba) paired with a wrapper (Iro) tied around the waist

name: Senator / Safari
description: A structured tunic top with Mandarin collar, typically worn with matching trousers. Popular Nigerian male formal wear

name: Dashiki
description: A colorful, loose-fitting garment with an ornate V-shaped collar and embroidery on the chest

name: Jumpsuit
description: A one-piece garment combining a top and trousers

name: Aso Oke Set
description: Hand-woven cloth from Yorubaland, worn as a complete set — Aso Oke, Gele (headtie), and Ipele (shoulder piece)

name: Boubou
description: A wide, flowing robe with elaborate embroidery, common across West Africa

name: Wrapper Dress
description: A fitted dress made from traditional African print fabric (Ankara, Adire), often with modern styling elements

name: Fit-and-Flare Dress
description: Fitted through the bodice and waist, then flaring out from the waist into a fuller skirt that stops around the knee

name: Sheath Dress
description: A straight, close-fitting dress shaped with darts, following the body from shoulder to hem without a waist seam

name: Ball Gown
description: A fitted bodice joined to a very full, floor-length skirt held out with layers or a petticoat

name: Bodycon Dress
description: A figure-hugging dress cut close to the body all over, usually in a stretch fabric, ending at or above the knee

name: Flowing Maxi Dress
description: A long, loose dress that falls to the ankle or floor from the bust or waist, with soft movement

name: Shirt Dress
description: A dress cut like a long shirt, with a collar, button front and often a belt or tie at the waist

name: Slip Dress
description: A simple bias-cut dress on thin straps that skims the body and drapes softly

name: Empire-Waist Dress
description: A raised waistline sitting just under the bust, with the skirt falling loosely from there

name: Kimono Gown
description: A wrap-front gown with wide, kimono-style sleeves cut in one with the body, tied or belted at the waist

name: Corset Gown
description: A structured, boned bodice that shapes the waist, joined to a long skirt

name: Peplum Dress
description: A fitted dress with a short flared ruffle or panel at the waist that falls over the hips

name: Tiered Dress
description: A dress whose skirt is built from horizontal layers, each gathered and slightly fuller than the one above

name: Mermaid Gown
description: Fitted from the bust through the hips and knees, then flaring dramatically below the knee into a fishtail

name: Asymmetric Hem Dress
description: A dress whose hem is cut at an angle or longer on one side, for movement and a modern line

name: Bubu Kaftan Gown
description: A wide, flowing floor-length gown cut as one generous piece with deep armholes, often embellished at the neck

name: Wide-Leg Jumpsuit
description: A one-piece jumpsuit with a fitted top and wide, flowing trouser legs

name: Wrap Jumpsuit
description: A jumpsuit with a crossover wrap front tied at the waist, and straight or tapered legs

name: Tailored Jumpsuit
description: A sharply cut jumpsuit with a collar or lapels, defined waist and pressed straight legs

name: Playsuit
description: A one-piece outfit with a top joined to shorts, light and easy to wear

name: Fitted Buba & Iro
description: A shaped, close-fitting buba blouse worn with a wrapped iro skirt, more tailored than the loose traditional cut

name: Off-Shoulder Buba & Iro
description: A buba blouse cut off the shoulders with a wrapped iro, a modern take on the traditional set

name: Skirt and Blouse Set
description: A matching top and skirt in the same fabric, often ankara or lace, worn together as one look

name: Embroidered Agbada
description: A wide flowing agbada robe with heavy embroidery around the neck, chest and pocket, worn over an inner top and trousers

name: Minimalist Agbada
description: A clean agbada robe with little or no embroidery, letting the fabric and the drape do the talking

name: Knee-Length Agbada
description: A shorter agbada robe that ends around the knee, lighter and easier to move in than the full-length robe

name: Babban Riga Agbada
description: The northern grand robe: a very wide, floor-length agbada with large embroidered panels on the chest and back

name: Jalabiya Kaftan
description: An ankle-length, loose kaftan with long sleeves and a simple collarless neck

name: Embroidered-Neck Kaftan
description: A knee-length kaftan with embroidery framing the neck opening and the front placket

name: Short Kaftan
description: A hip-length kaftan tunic worn over matching trousers, sharper and more casual than the long kaftan

name: Mandarin-Collar Kaftan
description: A kaftan finished with a short standing collar instead of an open neck

name: Double-Breasted Senator
description: A senator top that closes across the chest with two rows of buttons, worn with matching trousers

name: Senator with Chest Pocket
description: A straight senator top with a single chest pocket and a side-buttoned placket, worn with matching trousers

name: Henley Placket
description: A round neck with a short buttoned placket opening at the front

name: Split Neck
description: A round neck with a straight slit down the centre front, common on kaftans and tunics

name: Embroidered Neck Placket
description: A neck opening framed by a panel of embroidery down the front, the classic finish on a kaftan

name: Polo Placket
description: A soft folded collar with a two- or three-button placket at the front

name: Button-Down Collar
description: A shirt collar whose points fasten to the shirt with small buttons

name: Cutaway Collar
description: A shirt collar with points cut wide apart, made for a larger tie knot

name: Wing Collar
description: A short standing collar with small points folded down, worn for black-tie and ceremonies

name: Club Collar
description: A shirt collar with rounded points

name: Cuban Collar
description: A flat, open collar that lies against the chest with no top button, for relaxed shirts

name: Peak Lapel
description: A jacket lapel whose points sweep up toward the shoulders, sharper and more formal than a notch

name: Buttoned Cuff Sleeve
description: A long shirt sleeve finished with a buttoned cuff at the wrist

name: French Cuff Sleeve
description: A long sleeve with a deep cuff folded back and closed with cufflinks

name: Wide Kaftan Sleeve
description: A long, straight sleeve that widens toward the wrist with an open, unbuttoned end

name: Pleated Trouser
description: A tailored trouser with front pleats at the waist for room through the hip and thigh

name: Slim-Fit Trouser
description: A trouser cut close through the thigh and narrowing to the ankle

name: Sokoto Trouser
description: A traditional trouser with a drawstring waist, roomy through the leg and gathered at the ankle, worn under agbada and kaftan

name: Cropped Ankle Trouser
description: A straight or tapered trouser that stops just above the ankle

name: High Neck
description: A neckline that rises up the neck, covering the collarbone

name: Asymmetric Neck
description: A neckline cut at a slant, higher on one side than the other

name: Strapless
description: A straight or gently curved top edge with no straps, held in place by a fitted bodice

name: Queen Anne Neck
description: A high collar at the back of the neck that opens into a sweetheart or V shape at the front

name: Bow Tie Neck
description: A neckline finished with long ties that knot into a soft bow at the throat

name: Bishop Sleeve
description: A long sleeve that is fitted at the shoulder, widens toward the wrist and is gathered into a cuff

name: Lantern Sleeve
description: A sleeve that balloons out in the middle and narrows again at the wrist or elbow, like a lantern

name: Leg-of-Mutton Sleeve
description: A sleeve full and puffed at the shoulder that tapers to a fitted forearm and wrist

name: Cold-Shoulder Sleeve
description: A sleeve with a cut-out at the top of the shoulder, leaving the shoulder bare

name: Ruffle Sleeve
description: A short sleeve made of layered ruffles that fall over the upper arm

name: Tulip Skirt
description: A skirt with overlapping front panels that curve like tulip petals, fuller at the hip and narrower at the hem

name: Full Circle Skirt
description: A skirt cut as a full circle of fabric, so it falls in deep folds and swirls when you move

name: Tiered Skirt
description: A skirt built from layered tiers, each gathered and fuller than the one above

name: Front-Slit Skirt
description: A straight or fitted skirt with a slit at the front or side for movement

name: Trumpet Skirt
description: Fitted through the hip and thigh, flaring gradually from mid-thigh to the hem

name: Cigarette Trouser
description: A slim, straight trouser that ends at the ankle, neat and narrow all the way down

name: Culottes
description: A wide, cropped trouser that falls to mid-calf and moves like a skirt

name: Paperbag-Waist Trouser
description: A high-waisted trouser gathered at the waist with a ruffled top edge and a tie belt
